content: Number recognition is the ability to identify and name numbers by sight. It is a foundational mathematics skill for early learners. Students learn to recognize numerals such as 1, 2, 3 and associate each numeral with the quantity it represents. Number recognition forms the basis for counting, addition, and all further arithmetic.
